forkChangesPreserved: Provider-aware runtime-mode selection and summary labels, including the Pretty Auto/Yolo behavior represented by runtimeModeChoicesForProvider and selectedModelProviderDriver.
Pretty’s descriptor-aware model identity and model-detail summary via buildThreadModelIdentity.
Pretty’s hiding of inapplicable settings and inline select behavior via visibleSheetOptionDescriptors and usesInlineSelectChoices.
Thread-settings close-reason integration used by the fork’s sheet presentation lifecycle.
Animated catalog and option presentation remains present through the parent’s first-party Reanimated replacement rather than the superseded fork-only LayoutAnimation implementation.
T3 Pretty's compact disclosure-row spacing and opacity-based pressed feedback remain intact, with the upstream minimum touch height added non-destructively.
T3 Pretty's switch-row spacing and visual treatment remain intact around the parent's accessible native Switch behavior.

The session contract continues to accept multiple provider groups and retains model selection, provider option descriptors, option-selection updates, and runtime-mode callbacks, so T3 Pretty provider handoff and model-specific settings can remain wired through the parent route architecture.
Kimi runtime modes retain T3 Pretty's Auto/Yolo presentation instead of reverting to generic runtime labels.
Runtime choices follow the staged model's provider before Save, matching the staged option rows.
Inapplicable model settings remain hidden in the picker through visibleSheetOptionDescriptors.
Raw staged descriptors remain available to applyProviderOptionSelection so hiding rows does not discard unrelated option selections.
Legacy visibility remains controlled by the existing opt-in toggle and surrounding Pretty filtering behavior.

The existing T3 Pretty ThreadSettingsMainContent remains authoritative for the settings body, including fork-specific model presentation, applicable-setting filtering, runtime-mode presentation, and staged Save/Done behavior.
The surrounding T3 Pretty native-sheet presentation, theming, navigation, Android header behavior, and iOS toolbar behavior remain unchanged.
The resolution avoids restoring the obsolete duplicate JSX body, so the current session-backed architecture and its fork adaptations are not shadowed or duplicated.
upstreamChangesIntegrated: Parent React context/hooks and TextInput support for the redesigned thread-settings flow.
Native stack header toolbar, liquid-glass capability, sheet surface styling, scroll-edge effects, and new-task-flow integration.
Native mail-style model search toolbar and catalog query filtering.
Parent provider-option descriptor resolution and provider-section collapse-state helpers.
The thread-settings-options module split, including parent runtime choices and selectable-choice utilities.
Reanimated catalog/option layout, enter, and exit transitions plus stable visible-content positioning; these replace the fork-only LayoutAnimation copy.
Adopted the parent's first-party native thread-settings route/session architecture in place of the fork-only exported RN Modal declaration.
Adopted the `ThreadSettingsSubmenuPage` rename and the parent's runtime submenu-page support.
Added the upstream `min-h-11` touch-target sizing to disclosure and switch rows.
Added the upstream accessibility label to the Switch and followed the upstream removal of the legacy `ios_backgroundColor` override.
Memoized staged descriptor calculation and the parent's memoized legacy-model detection are retained.
The refactored ThreadSettingsSession context supplies choice-page state and update callbacks.
Choice routing uses the parent's ThreadSettingsSubmenuPage discriminant and descriptor ID lookup.
Runtime and descriptor selections use the parent's onSelected navigation completion callback.
Upstream runtime-choice descriptions are shown, with canonical descriptions applied to Pretty-specific runtime labels when needed.
Integrated the parent’s native iOS Provider submenu with an All providers action and one action per session provider group.
Integrated session-backed provider filtering through session.providerFilter and session.setProviderFilter.
Integrated the conditional Show legacy models menu action, including its session-backed toggle and omission when no legacy models exist.
Retained the parent refactor that renders the settings body through ThreadSettingsMainContent rather than duplicating the former inline implementation.
